parsedReport.summary: Sprint 5 served as an architecture buffer and planning period to prepare for upcoming development efforts. The team utilized this dedicated timeframe to align on technical strategy, evaluate architectural options, and refine future backlog items. This focus established a solid technical foundation and clear direction for the next iteration.
highlights: Successfully dedicated focus to high-level architectural planning and technical alignment.
Refined upcoming backlog items to prepare for seamless future execution.
Utilized buffer time effectively to address foundational architectural spikes.
